title: PR #47050 added the project-scoped rule snooze (mute) endpoint, which loads the issue/metric alert rule by id alone without scoping it to the project in the URL, so a user can mute alert rules in other organizations.

findings.explanation: The change only adds argument conversion and queryset filtering using Django ORM; no raw SQL strings are constructed from user input.

Rule lookup is now scoped to the project (and for AlertRule via fetch_for_project), preventing access to rules outside the user's authorized project. Permission classes already enforce project-level access, eliminating IDOR and missing authorization risks.
